messages.text: Got it — since you want something floor standing rather than a desktop piece, the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe is our top floor pick: it's a large, hand-assembled heirloom globe with a raised relief antique map that lights up, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand, so it makes a real statement in a room. If you'd rather keep the bright, crisp blue-ocean look of the Livingston you were just viewing but in a floor model, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand is a great fit too. You'll find either one under its exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
